gloss: to appear on the market, to circulate

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {出回|でまわ}りませんでした

forms.negative: {出回|でまわ}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {出回|でまわ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to appear on the market, to be widely available, to circulate
definitions.explanation: For goods, products, or information to become widely available or to spread through circulation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新米|しんまい}→新米：06877_shinmai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出回|でまわ}る⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's the season when new rice appears on the market.

examples.japanese: ⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出回|でまわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Counterfeit goods are circulating in the market.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{山菜|さんさい}→山菜：12404_sansai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{店頭|てんとう}→店頭：12488_tentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出回|でまわ}り{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: When spring comes, fresh mountain vegetables start appearing in stores.

notes:
Compound verb from ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to come out) + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around). Describes goods, products, or information becoming widely available.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- No transitive pair

ASPECT (ている):
- {出回|でまわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = is circulating, is widely available (ongoing state)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出回|でまわ}る (to appear on the market)
- ⟦{店頭|てんとう}→店頭：12488_tentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出回|でまわ}る (to appear in stores)
- ⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出回|でまわ}る (counterfeits circulate)
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出回|でまわ}る (information circulates)
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出回|でまわ}る⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧ (the time when ~ becomes available)

USAGE:
Often used for seasonal produce (⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧) appearing in stores, or negatively for counterfeit goods, rumors, or leaked information spreading.
